trunks: Support ECC key in trunks client * Add ECC parameter in `--key_create` and `--key_sign` to support generate the ECC key and using ECDSA to sign. * Add ECC public key display in `--key_info`. BUG=chromium:910485 TEST=manually # generate key trunks_client --key_create --ecc --usage=sign --key_blob=/tmp/k # load key and show $handle number HANDLE=$(trunks_client --key_load --key_blob=/tmp/k | \ sed 's/Loaded key handle: //') # Show key information trunks_client --key_info --handle=$HANDLE # Sign echo "ABCDEF" > /tmp/1.txt trunks_client --key_sign --handle=$HANDLE --ecc \ --data=/tmp/1.txt --signature=/tmp/1.sig # Verify Singature # Manually dump TPM public key and transform the key to openssl # format, then put it in ./pub . openssl dgst -sha256 -verify ./pub -signature /tmp/1.sig < /tmp/1.txt Change-Id: Idbccfa5efc0ec9e966fc61328e47b72ef335e1b6 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1356668 Commit-Ready: Meng-Huan Yu <menghuan@chromium.org> Tested-by: Meng-Huan Yu <menghuan@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org>

attestation: Rewrite GetRSAPublicKeyFromTpmPublicKey in tpm_utility_v2 The original flow serialized TPM Public Area everywhere before passing in GetRSAPublicKeyFromTpmPublicKey, and inside GetRSAPublicKeyFromTpmPublicKey will unpack it again. In this CL, I removed the unpack logic. Also, seperate GetRSAPublicKeyFromTpmPublicKey to 2 function that one is converting TPM Public Area to OpenSSL key, and the other one is converting OpenSSL key to DER encoded string. Such that, the later function can be reused regardless of key type in future ECC implemetation. In long term goal, if there is not use case of serialized TPM Public Area |public_key_tpm_format|, I plan to remove it from each key related functions in tpm_utility. * Remove GetRSAPublicKeyFromTpmPublicKey() in tpm_utility_v2 * Create OpenSSL converting function in tpm_utility which follows the crypto utility in chaps. * GetRSAPublicKeyFromTpmPublicArea * RsaPublicKeyToString BUG=chromium:910519 TEST=passed unit test Change-Id: I47f30fb048af4c40a4542a91ea0a9f04227856b0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1480891 Commit-Ready: Meng-Huan Yu <menghuan@chromium.org> Tested-by: Meng-Huan Yu <menghuan@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org>
